name: Mövenpick Myth Hotel Patong Phuket
short_description: A 235-room Art Deco-inspired hotel in central Patong with a free-form pool and Deluxe Pool Access rooms featuring private outdoor jacuzzis.
ai_summary: Mövenpick Myth Hotel Patong Phuket is a 235-room hotel in central Patong built around an Art Deco design theme, with an art-deco inspired restaurant and lobby bar and a free-form swimming pool at its center. Deluxe Pool Access rooms pair private outdoor jacuzzis with direct pool access, while standard rooms include 43-inch smart TVs and separate bathtub-and-rain-shower bathrooms. Guest reviews are strongly positive, with the property's chandeliers and Art Deco lobby design, diverse breakfast buffet spanning Chinese, Middle Eastern, and Indian dishes, and central Patong location repeatedly praised, though as a mid-tier Patong hotel it draws mixed comment on whether the experience matches its four-star positioning.

faqs.question: Does Mövenpick Myth Hotel Patong Phuket have pool access rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes -- its Deluxe Pool Access rooms are 43 square meters and pair a private outdoor jacuzzi with direct access to the hotel's free-form pool, alongside a 43-inch smart TV and a bathroom with a separate bathtub and walk-in rain shower.

faqs.question: Is Mövenpick Myth Hotel Patong Phuket in central Patong?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits in central Patong, close to restaurants, massage salons, and the area's nightlife, with an Art Deco design theme throughout the lobby and restaurant that distinguishes it from most other hotels in the same part of Phuket.
